notes.title: Information Project Rayssus Release content and Server Open Schedule
notes.notes:
Hello, we are RS Games.

Project Rayssus Early Access service will begin on June 19, 2024.

Before launching the service, we will introduce you to the detailed service schedule and related content.

1. Service Launch Schedule

[strike]- Client Download: June 19, 2024 at 6:00 am (KST)
- Server opening and service commencement: June 19, 2024 at 8:30 a.m. (KST)
[/strike]

- Client Download: June 19, 2024 at 11:00 pm (KST)
- Server opening and service commencement: June 20, 2024 at 00:00 a.m. (KST)

[strike]*The final inspection and optimization of the server have been delayed, so there are some changes in the schedule. We ask for your understanding

! Additional announcement at 5:10 AM, Jun 19, 2024!
During the final inspection of the server, some of the information transmission between players during multiplayer is
We have identified missing or lost issues. Corrections and recovery procedures for issues have been entered
I needed a little more time, so I inevitably adjusted the time to the afternoon.[/strike]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Additional delay reason guidance

Although the issue of missing or losing transmission details between players was corrected and inspected
There is no problem with our system, so during the detailed inspection, has been identified as a problem with the network line itself and is currently in the process of replacing the network we use it for the server.

As network replacement is carried out through telecommunication companies, not us, line replacement and network reconstruction are carried out
It has become a necessary situation and inevitably needs more time.

The line we use for the server is SK Broadband corporate line
The reason for the replacement of the line is the old line of the internal network of the building connected to our office
Data loss and delay due to some corruption or setup errors.

If the work is completed earlier than the scheduled time, we will notify you immediately and proceed with the release.

Please understand this.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

2. Service Content and System Guide

- A new server, 'GramAce' and 'Aerostinger' will be opened.

- Cross-platform functionality is supported.
* The account you purchased and played on Steam can also be linked to Project Racers on other platforms.

- 6 Playable Rayssus will be rolled out.

[Lightweight Rayssus]: Aerostinger, Stingray
[Standard Rayssus]: Gram-Ace, Helios, White Illusion
[Heavyweight Rayssus] : Still Guardian

-Playable armament will be rolled out.
[Main weapon - Assualt Rifle]: Helio striker, energy spitter
[Main weapon - Long Range Rifle] : Revolve Chaser, Plasma Precher
[Main weapon - Shotgun]: Helio Stayner, energy shocker

[Secondary weapon - Energy blaster] : Plasma radian, energy cast
[Secondary weapon - Missile launcher] : Quad Tamer, burst carrier
[Secondary weapon - Bazooka] : Slinger shot, Storm Bringer

[Melee weapon - Blade] : Static edge, particle slicer
[Melee Weapon - Spear] : Static Pierce. Spread Edge
[Melee weapon - Scythe] : Static slicer, DeathScythe

[Defensive Weapon - Shield]: Gram Defender, Aero Dispenser, Helio Reflector

- The following game modes will be opened.

[One-man play - Arena mode]
PVE mode for a one-on-one battle against the AI Racers.
Arena rank rises with Arena points earned by play.
The higher the Arena rank, the more open the battle against the stronger Racers

*At this point, the open rank is Frank level 8, and the maximum liftable rank is also up to Frank level 8.

[1 player play - Standard mode]
As a normal PVE mode, we remove UIE from various conditions and maps and earn rewards as we achieve our mission goals.
This mission can be repeated continuously.

*Arrive point: The mission is to remove the UIE and arrive at the designated target location within the limited time.
*Wave Stand: The mission is to endure by removing UIE that has been attacking periodically for a limited time.
*Tower Defense: A mission to defend the energy tower by preventing UIE that has been attacking periodically for a limited time.
*Clean Area: Mission to remove all UIEs that exist within the area for a limited time.

[Online Play - PVE Mode]
It is a mode in which missions in the standard mode can be cleared in cooperation with other users or friends through online matching.

*At this point, there are two modes supported: Wavestand and Tower Defense.

[Online Play - PVP Mode]
It's a mode where players can play against each other through online matching

*Deathmatch: A mission to shoot down the racers of all players other than yourself as much as possible for a limited time to earn the highest points.

*Team Death Match: This is a mission to shoot down the opponent's Racers as much as possible with your team members, including yourself, and the team that scores a high point wins.

- Interface functions
The rollover tooltip function is enabled.
When you mouse over a question mark icon on a numerical value or UI, it displays the details of that content.

The store function will be activated.
With the credits earned from Mission Play, you can buy or resell the parts, weapons, and skills you need in the store.

The hangar function is activated.
Combine the parts you have in the hangar, combine your own racers, and save them as a preset.

The user information function is activated.
You can check and set play history, weapon proficiency, and performance numerical stat.

*Activation functions may vary depending on the pre-launch server environment and whether it is optimized.

It's just around the corner. We'll do our best to wrap it up until the launch goes well.

notes.title: Project Rayssus Release schedule guide(24/06/06 14:20 Modify)
notes.notes:
Hello, we're RS Games

Here is a brief introduction to the upcoming launch schedule and related details of the Project Rayssus

-Schedule related to release and content-
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40608495/71432270fd7407b021ec4828cfe40d9620ae28c5.png
June 6th at 10 p.m. - Beta access service will proceed

What is beta access? 
An open beta service period during which system optimization and feedback are received prior to early access service.
There may be sudden checks or server instability during that period.

June 18 - Early Access Service Proceeds 

The feedback and optimization collected during the beta access period will be applied and restricted content will be lifted.
Early access will last one year from that date.

-First Rollout Rayssus-
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40608495/b9f9cafb2333ae26543f7f883674eebfe5366731.png
Four Rayssus roll out with beta and early access service launch.

[Standard Rayssus] GramAce / Helios
[LightWeight Rayssus] AeroStinger
[HeavyWeight Rayssus] SteelGuardian

-Beta and Early Access Mission Content-
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40608495/45a86126119f323dcb966fe32315a8b0d1f69a93.png
The mission content that can be played with beta and early access services is as follows. 

Offline Play Mode
- Arena: A mode in which you compete for a one-on-one battle against the AI-controlled Rayssus to earn rewards based on winning or losing.
- Standard: It is a normal PVE mode that can be played repeatedly.

Online Play Mode
-PVE Co-op Mode: A cooperative mode that allows you to play standard mode with players or friends worldwide.
-PVP Death Match: PVP mode in which up to 8 people single-handedly shoot down as many opponent Rayssus as possible to win or lose.
-PVP Team Death Match: A team PVP mode in which up to 16 people shoot down the opponent's Rayssus to win or lose.

*Corrected on June 6, 2024, 2:20 PM
Regarding the release schedule, we requested Steam to inspect the release schedule and the final procedure.
However, I received the information from Steam that it will take 1 to 2 more days to inspect the schedule and proceed with the procedure

There are no other changes in the schedule. Please understand this

Network Play Guide
Project Rayssus is an online game, so if you can't connect to the network, you can't play the game.
In addition, since it is a global integrated server, there may be ping differences between users by region.

Republic of Korea - 10–30 ms / Japan 40–70 ms / EU & North America 90–130 ms
* If the ping difference is more than 300ms different or unstable, the connection to the server is terminated or KickOut by the multiplay's room by system during
